title: Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi Kauli ya: (Theme 11: Majukumu ya watoto)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child changes the verb end for doing (-a), doing for someone (-ia/-ea) and being done to (-wa), choosing the vowel by the stem.
steps: Doer, for someone, or done to?
Add the ending by the vowel rule.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitenzi kipi katika kauli ya kutendea?" Kwa nini "pikwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kutendea huonyesha kwa ajili ya nani, kama pikia.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitenzi kipi katika kauli ya kutendwa?" Kwa nini "pikia" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kutendwa huonyesha anayepokea tendo, kama pikwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitenzi kipi katika kauli ya kutenda?" Kwa nini "pikwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kutenda ni umbo la kawaida, kama pika.
